definitions.explanation: A person of advanced age; senior citizens as a group.

examples.japanese: {年寄|としよ}りには{席|せき}を{譲|ゆず}りましょう。
examples.english: Let's give up our seats to the elderly.

examples.japanese: {年寄|としよ}りの{話|はなし}は{勉強|べんきょう}になる。
examples.english: Stories from the elderly are educational.

examples.japanese: {年寄|としよ}り{扱|あつか}いされたくない。
examples.english: I don't want to be treated like an old person.

notes:
KANJI: Can also be written as {年寄り|としより} with okurigana.

USAGE: While not inherently impolite, this term can feel casual or slightly blunt. More polite alternatives exist.

MORE POLITE ALTERNATIVES:
・お{年寄|としよ}り (adding お makes it more polite)
・{高齢者|こうれいしゃ} (senior citizen - formal)
・{老人|ろうじん} (old person - neutral/formal)
・ご{老人|ろうじん} (elderly person - respectful)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・お{年寄|としよ}りを{大切|たいせつ}にする (to treat the elderly with care)
・{年寄|としよ}り{臭|くさ}い (acting/looking old - slightly negative)

CONTRAST:
・{若者|わかもの} (young person) - opposite
